name: stdClassSum_period_eq_zero
summary: Turn the class sum into a theta period of a sum of products of theta kernels with matrix coefficients of Ξ over U(I_l) ⊂ U(I_n); by period_eq_zero this period is a theta lift of the coefficients to W ⊕ ℍ^N, which vanishes by descentsVanish_hypSum; a nonzero theta value at a real vector divides out.

    x * A))
